description: Implement all admin screens, update AdminNavigator to full 5-tab layout, and upgrade AdminHomeScreen to live data. Independent from FEAT-002 — can be implemented in any order after FEAT-001. Adds admin-facing service call functions to existing service files (serviceService, bookingService, paymentService) rather than creating a separate adminService to keep the service layer DRY.
steps: CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminBookingsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Bookings'. Horizontal status filter tabs: All, Pending, Confirmed, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled. FlatList of BookingCards (using existing component). Load via bookingService.getAdminBookings({status}) which calls GET /admin/bookings?status=X. Pull-to-refresh. Tap navigates to AdminBookingDetails. LoadingView, EmptyState.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminBookingDetailsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Booking Details' with back. Loads booking from route.params.bookingId via bookingService.getAdminBookings then find, or ideally add getAdminBooking(id) → api.get('/admin/bookings/'+id) to bookingService.js. Shows all booking fields. Status update picker: scrollable list of status chips (confirmed/in_progress/completed/cancelled). 'Update Status' AppButton calls bookingService.updateBookingStatus(id, status). Shows customer info (name, phone), vehicle info, service info, payment status.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminServicesScreen.js — AppHeader 'Services' with + button. FlatList of service rows showing name, category badge, price, duration, active/inactive toggle (Switch or icon button). Load all services via api.get('/admin/services') if available, or filter from serviceService.getServices() result. Tap row navigates to EditService. Delete with ConfirmDialog calls serviceService.deleteService(id). FAB or header + button navigates to AddService.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AddServiceScreen.js — AppHeader 'Add Service' with back. Form: name (AppInput), description (AppInput multiline), category picker (Exterior/Interior/Full/Premium), vehicleTypes multi-select (checkbox-style TouchableOpacity chips from VEHICLE_TYPES), price (AppInput numeric), duration (AppInput numeric, minutes), imageUrl (AppInput optional). Submit calls serviceService.createService(data). Inline validation. Navigate back on success.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/EditServiceScreen.js — identical structure to AddService but pre-fills from route.params.service and calls serviceService.updateService(id, data). AppHeader 'Edit Service'.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminCustomersScreen.js — AppHeader 'Customers'. TextInput search bar (debounced, searches by name). FlatList showing customer name, email, phone, booking count (if available), StatusBadge (active/inactive). Load via api.get('/admin/customers', {params:{search, page}}). Tap navigates to AdminCustomerDetails. Pull-to-refresh. EmptyState. LoadingView.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminCustomerDetailsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Customer Details' with back. Shows: avatar initials circle, name, email, phone, member since, isActive status. Recent bookings list (last 5). 'Activate'/'Deactivate' toggle AppButton with ConfirmDialog (calls api.put('/admin/customers/'+id+'/toggle')). LoadingView while loading.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminVehiclesScreen.js — AppHeader 'Vehicles'. FlatList of vehicle rows showing type icon, make+model, owner name, license plate. Load via api.get('/admin/vehicles'). Search by license plate or owner name (client-side filter). Pull-to-refresh. EmptyState. Read-only view (admin cannot edit customer vehicles).

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminPaymentsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Payments'. Status filter tabs: All, Pending, Paid, Failed, Refunded. FlatList showing payment method badge, amount, customer name, booking service name, date, status. Load via paymentService.getAdminPayments({status}). Tap shows detail inline or in modal. 'Mark Paid' action for COD pending payments (calls paymentService.updatePaymentStatus(id,'paid')). Pull-to-refresh.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminCalendarScreen.js — AppHeader 'Calendar'. Shows current month in a 7-col grid. Each day cell shows booking count as a badge (fetch summary from GET /admin/bookings?month=YYYY-MM or client-side from loaded bookings). Navigate months with prev/next arrows. Tap day navigates to AdminSchedule screen for that date passing the date as param.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminScheduleScreen.js — AppHeader 'Schedule' with date shown in subtitle. Receives date from route.params.date. Loads schedule via api.get('/availability?date='+date) for slot availability and optionally GET /admin/bookings?date=X for bookings. Shows: open/close toggle for the day (calls api.post('/admin/schedule', {date, isOpen})), max bookings input, time slot grid with available/booked status. 'Save' button. List of bookings for the day below.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Reports'. Load via api.get('/admin/reports'). Shows stat cards: Total Bookings, Total Revenue (₹), Today's Bookings, This Month Revenue, Total Customers. Status breakdown as a simple horizontal bar chart built from View components (each status row has a colored bar whose width is proportional to its count as a flex value). No external chart library needed.

CREATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminSettingsScreen.js — AppHeader 'Settings'. Shows: admin profile card (name, email, role badge). Menu items: Change Password (navigates to or opens modal for change password flow using authService.changePassword), App Version (read from Constants.expoConfig.version), About PROWASH (tagline, version). Logout row at bottom with ConfirmDialog.

UPDATE mobile/src/navigation/AdminNavigator.js — replace stub with full bottom-tab implementation. 5 tabs: Dashboard (AdminHome), Bookings (stack: AdminBookings → AdminBookingDetails), Services (stack: AdminServices → AddService, EditService), Customers (stack: AdminCustomers → AdminCustomerDetails → AdminVehicles sub-screen), More (stack: AdminPayments, AdminCalendar → AdminSchedule, AdminReports, AdminSettings). Tab icons: grid-outline, calendar-outline, sparkles-outline, people-outline, ellipsis-horizontal-outline.

UPDATE mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminHomeScreen.js — replace '--' stat placeholders with real data. Fetch from api.get('/admin/reports') on mount. Show real values for Bookings Today, Pending, Revenue (today or total), Customers. Also show a Recent Bookings section (last 5 bookings as compact rows). Pull-to-refresh. LoadingView on initial load.
acceptance_criteria: All admin screens exist in mobile/src/screens/admin/: AdminBookings, AdminBookingDetails, AdminServices, AddService, EditService, AdminCustomers, AdminCustomerDetails, AdminVehicles, AdminPayments, AdminCalendar, AdminSchedule, AdminReports, AdminSettings
AdminNavigator.js implements 5 bottom tabs with proper nested stacks for all admin screens
AdminHomeScreen.js fetches live data from /admin/reports and displays real stats
'cd mobile && npx expo export --platform android' exits 0 with no errors
verification: cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\mobile && npx expo export --platform android -- confirm exit code 0 and 'Export was successful' in output
findings: All 13 admin screens created and committed. AdminNavigator replaced with full 5-tab bottom-tab layout (Dashboard, Bookings, Services, Customers, More) using nested stacks throughout. AdminHomeScreen upgraded from stub to live data fetching from /admin/reports with pull-to-refresh and recent bookings list. AdminBookingsScreen: status filter tabs + FlatList with pull-to-refresh. AdminBookingDetailsScreen: full booking info with inline status chip selector. AdminServicesScreen: service rows with Switch toggle + delete. AddServiceScreen/EditServiceScreen: full form with category and vehicle type chip selectors. AdminCustomersScreen: debounced search + customer rows. AdminCustomerDetailsScreen: avatar, info, activate/deactivate toggle with ConfirmDialog, recent bookings list. AdminVehiclesScreen: read-only vehicle list with client-side filter. AdminPaymentsScreen: status filter tabs + Mark Paid action for COD pending. AdminCalendarScreen: pure React Native 7-column grid calendar with booking count badges per day, month navigation. AdminScheduleScreen: isOpen toggle, maxBookings input, slot grid, bookings list for day. AdminReportsScreen: stat cards + horizontal flex-based bar chart (no external library). AdminSettingsScreen: profile card, change password inline form, app version, logout with ConfirmDialog. Build confirmed: npx expo export --platform android exits 0 with 1160 modules bundled. Integration fix (cross-feat): adminController.js response keys renamed from monthRevenue/totalActiveCustomers to thisMonthRevenue/totalCustomers to match mobile screen expectations. bookingController.js getAllBookings response renamed items to bookings to match AdminBookingsScreen/AdminHomeScreen extraction. adminRoutes.js now includes GET /bookings/:id for single booking fetch (AdminBookingDetailsScreen primary path). Server confirmed starting cleanly after all fixes.
